svg.title: AI-Assist — request/response sequence
svg.desc: AI-Assist request and response sequence: 1 the watch or iPhone sends the turn over a signed device session with rate limiting; 2 the gateway applies the context policy and reserves budget; 3 the model router picks from the catalog with no silent fallback; 4 the adapter calls the provider, which today is a mock or simulated provider; 5 deltas stream back; 6 the gateway persists the message and settles the cost; 7 the client receives the response over server-sent events; sanitized log events are written throughout.
